verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email app, but the evidence shows Gmail only as a Google-hosted service. Nothing indicates it can be self-hosted or that the mail pipeline can run on infrastructure the user controls. IMAP/POP/SMTP access from third-party clients and custom-domain Workspace email are adjacent features: they still run on Google's servers, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
